item.infernalpages.scripture.tooltip: Holds the power to permanently end a life.
item.infernalpages.scripture.tooltip2: Kill a player while holding this to banish them. Single use.
item.infernalpages.revival_charm.tooltip: Hold this and type a banished player's name in chat to revive them. Single use.
item.infernalpages.contract.tooltip: Right-click to sign. Two different players must sign to seal the pact.
item.infernalpages.unholy_charm.tooltip: Bound to a doomed soul. Type their name in chat to end them. Single use.
item.infernalpages.contract_sword.toolti: Bound to its owner. Killing players permanently banishes them. Reusable.
Can never harm the other signer of the pact.
item.infernalpages.purity_seal.tooltip: Right-click to cleanse your soul, or break a pact by clicking its signer in a ritual.
item.infernalpages.revival_charm.tooltip: Smash it on a block tougher than stone to forge a Purity Seal.
item.infernalpages.mould_of_souls.toolti: Right-click a block to summon a soul guardian that attacks intruders.
item.infernalpages.tainted_shard.tooltip: A shard of a broken sword, steeped in a tainted past. Combine three to forge the weapon.
item.infernalpages.tainted_remains: The Remains of a Tainted Past
item.infernalpages.tainted_remains.toolt: Shift-right-click to swap between sword and hoe mode.
item.infernalpages.tainted_remains.taint: Tainted: blocks the next hit of damage, then recharges over 15 seconds.
item.infernalpages.calling_horn.tooltip: Summons all your soul moulds to you.
